exam_scheme.note: The APPSCCE consists of two successive stages: Preliminary Examination (Objective type screening test comprising 2 papers of 200 marks each) and Main Examination (8 written descriptive papers totaling 1,750 merit marks plus a 300-mark qualifying English paper, followed by an Interview / Viva-Voce Personality Test of 275 marks).

financial_package.note: Arunachal Pradesh Civil Service (Entry Grade) Group-A posts are compensated under the Arunachal Pradesh Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, adhering to the 7th Central Pay Commission Pay Matrix. The premier executive posts (APCS Entry Grade / EAC / Circle Officer and APPS Police Service Entry Grade) start at Pay Matrix Level 10 (Pay Band 3: ₹15,600 - 39,100, Grade Pay ₹5,400) with entry basic pay of ₹56,100.
financial_package.pay_source_label: APPSC Advt. No. 5/2026: Combined Competitive Examination-2026 & Government of Arunachal Pradesh 7th CPC Revised Pay Matrix Level 10
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Pay Matrix Level 10 entry basic pay of ₹56,100 at 58% DA (effective 1 Jul 2025), plus Special Duty Allowance (SDA @ 10% of basic pay for North East Region postings = ₹5,610), House Rent Allowance (HRA @ 9% to 18% depending on posting location in Itanagar/districts), and remote/difficult area allowances; in-hand reflects standard deductions for NPS (10% on Basic+DA) and state insurance.
official_perks: Government residential accommodation or HRA in lieu thereof
Special Duty Allowance (SDA) of 10% on Basic Pay for postings in North Eastern Region
Official vehicle with driver or transport entitlement for field and executive duties
Special Compensatory Remote Locality Allowance (SCRLA) for tough/border terrain postings
Comprehensive medical reimbursement under State Health Scheme / CS(MA) Rules
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and earned leave encashment as per state civil service rules
